name: Tantei Imasato Misa Jikenbo Tanpenshuu: Romance wa Shiroku Kiken na Kaori
original_name: 探偵今里美沙事件簿 短編集 ロマンスは白く危険な香り
source:
Tokyo, 1960s. Amateur detective Misa takes up a case in secret from her father detective. It starts as a romance request, but soon plot starts to thicken.
